facts.fact: The ministry page states that the Schéma Stratégique Intégré (SSI), the government roadmap that includes the National ICT Development Strategy, was adopted in 2014.
The page says the SSI was adopted in 2014 to develop the ICT sector over a period of 10 years, which ends in 2024.

systems.owner: Government of Djibouti (page of the Ministry of Communication, in charge of Posts and Telecommunications)
